source.provenance: Public GEODATA test case added in 2020; issue records a user-submitted 2010_1.dwg. The originating DWG producer is not identified. No source fixture or derivative is committed.

negativeControl.validation: Pinned independent verifier reported no container findings; one compressed HEADER page, exact declared section size, unique end sentinel, matching envelope size and CRC.

odaResave.producer: ODA File Converter 27.1.0, ACAD2010 DWG output, audit enabled
odaResave.validation: No .err file; pinned independent verifier reported no container findings; one compressed HEADER page, exact declared section size, unique end sentinel, matching envelope size and CRC.

suffixMutation.method: tools/research/mutate_ac1024_header_suffix_traced.py changes every suffix byte via 739 independent compressed literal roots, validates exact decoded bounds and checksums, and verifies independent decompression and container checks. Variants are scratch-only.
suffixMutation.observations: ODA converted all three resaved variants to DXF without .err files; outputs were byte-identical after normalizing only $TDUPDATE and $TDUUPDATE. LibreDWG 0.14 JSON outputs were byte-identical for all three, including its reported GEODATA. The output comparisons are among the ODA-resaved variants; no equivalence to the original source is asserted.

limits: A single source/resave pair establishes an observed producer transformation, not that every ODA output has a suffix or that the suffix has no semantics. Maintenance version 55 alone cannot require its presence. The original producer is unknown; the independent reader is not an independent suffix-producing implementation. Do not discard suffixes, infer padding, broaden support claims, or bypass strict refusal without separate source-backed semantics and qualification.
